verdict.rationale: Portkey documents itself as 'performant' and highlights caching for up to 20x faster responses plus an open-source gateway that can be self-hosted to minimize network hops, but there are no concrete latency-overhead benchmarks (e.g., added ms per request) or independent performance tests confirming minimal overhead. Missing for 10: published gateway-added-latency benchmarks, third-party/independent performance validation, and comparison data versus direct provider calls.
